_how: To translate Action Queue: copy this file in the same lang folder, name it after the language (ru.json, de.json...), put the language's own name in _meta.name ("Русский") and its culture in _meta.culture ("ru-RU"), then translate the texts. Keep every {place} as it is (you may move it or leave it out). A text with "one" and "other" depends on a number: give the forms your language has (Russian: one, few, many, other). Remove what you have not translated yet, or leave it in English: either way it shows in English. Names of items, skills and monsters come from the game. Choose the language in the Action Queue window (top right).

With every step in lane 1 the queue works as one list.

"at once" stops in the middle of a step; "when a round is over" lets the round finish first (the sale at the end still happens).

Ticked by itself while "Start over at the end" is on.

Your character never stands still: this runs while every step that is left is waiting
(for materials, for its skill to be free...) and goes on after the queue has finished.
It only takes a free slot, never one of your own actions, and stops when a step needs the place.

_notes.progress.nodes: {count} = g.Amount; {nodes} = Nodes(game, step, g); {kind} = Step.NodeKind(g.Subject, g.SubjectName)
_notes.queue.done_node_unlocks_already_earned: {nodes} = Nodes(game, step, already); {subjectName} = already.SubjectName; {mostNodes} = MostNodes(game, step.TargetId, already.Subject == "major")
